extracted_information: Dialogflow pricing is determined monthly by edition (Dialogflow CX or Dialogflow ES) and request volume. Trial credits are offered for new customers: $1,000 for Dialogflow CX with Generative AI (1 year validity) and $600 for Dialogflow CX without Generative AI (12 months validity). Pricing varies significantly between CX and ES for text, audio, and specific features like Generative AI, Data Store index storage, sentiment analysis, and phone gateways. Core features like design-time requests are generally free. 'Request' is defined as any API call, and 'session' is a conversation. No additional data transfer charges apply, but other Google Cloud resources used in tandem are billed separately. Capabilities for chatbots are inferred from supported features like Generative AI, speech recognition, and sentiment analysis. Limitations include request limits for the Dialogflow ES Trial Edition, referenced under 'Quotas & Limits'. Implementation considerations include managing multiple projects.

definitions.Generative AI: Agents using Playbooks, Data Stores, Generative fallbacks, or Generators.
definitions.Request: Any API call to the Dialogflow service (direct via API or indirect via integration/console).
definitions.Session: A conversation between an end-user and a Dialogflow agent, active for 30 minutes after the last request. Can be chat (text only) or voice (audio for requests/responses or both).
definitions.Consumer projects and resource projects: If multiple projects are used, the consumer project (associated with request authentication) determines prices and quotas, not the resource project (associated with the agent).

trial_credits.Dialogflow CX with Generative AI: $1,000 in trial credits, valid for 1 year from account signup.
trial_credits.Dialogflow CX without Generative AI: $600 credit for no-charge trial, activates automatically upon first use, expires after 12 months.

Dialogflow CX Agent Pricing.Data Store index storage: Free quota of 10 GiB per month, then $5.00 per GiB of additional raw data per month (calculated as average). For website data store, ~0.000477 GiB per page; e.g., 1000 page website = $2.38/month.

Essentials Edition.Text: $0.002 per request (Google Assistant requests not billed, considered text)
Essentials Edition.Audio input (STT): $0.0065 per 15 seconds of audio (rounded up, e.g., 7s billed as 15s, 15.14s billed as 30s)
Essentials Edition.Audio output (TTS): Standard voices: $4 per 1 million characters; WaveNet voices: $16 per 1 million characters
Essentials Edition.Sentiment analysis: 0-1 million requests: $1.00 per 1,000 requests; 1-5 million requests: $0.50 per 1,000 requests; 5-20 million requests: $0.25 per 1,000 requests
Essentials Edition.Dialogflow ES phone gateway: Tolled number: $0.05 per minute; Toll-free number: $0.06 per minute (call duration rounded up to whole minutes)
Essentials Edition.Mega agent: <=2k intents: $0.002 per request; >2k intents: $0.006 per request (cost based on number of intents searched)

Agent Assist Pricing.Agent Assist analyze text/audio operatio: Not available (Trial), charged according to underlying Conversational Agents (Dialogflow CX) Agent and Dialogflow ES Agent pricing (Essentials)

pricing.Network Costs: No additional data transfer charges associated with Dialogflow.
pricing.Google Cloud Platform Costs: Other Google Cloud resources used are billed separately (e.g., Google App Engine instances).

features: Generative AI features (playbooks, data stores, generators, generative fallback)
Audio input/output (speech recognition, speech-to-text, speech synthesis, text-to-speech, telephony)
Design-time read requests (e.g., list/get agent resources)
Other session requests (e.g., setting/getting session entities, updating/querying context)
Agent Assist for managing conversations and participants, and analyzing text/audio

temporal_info.Trial Credits Validity: Dialogflow CX Generative AI: 1 year from account signup. Dialogflow CX non-Generative AI: 12 months from first use.
temporal_info.Audio Billing Change: Minimum billed duration for voice sessions changed from one minute to one second, effective June 30, 2023.
